title: [Bug] The connection close confirmation is shown when closing the application if the option page was accessed after starting the application
author: sassy-lily
body_snippet:
If the options page has ever been opened after starting the application (even if it has later been closed), when closing the application the "Do you want to close all open connections?" pop-up is displayed, even if no connection were ever opened in the session.

The pop-up should only be shown if there are actual connections open.
